title: Rule `no-unexpected-multiline` does not detect case which line starts with `/`

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
<!--

-->

**Tell us about your environment**

* **ESLint Version:**
v3.19.0
* **Node Version:**
v6.10.1
* **npm Version:**
3.10.10
**What parser (default, Babel-ESLint, etc.) are you using?**
default
**Please show your full configuration:**

<!-- Paste your configuration below: -->
```
{
    "env": {
        "browser": true,
        "es6": true
    },
    "extends": "eslint:recommended",
    "rules": {
        "indent": [
            "error",
            "tab"
        ],
        "linebreak-style": [
            "error",
            "unix"
        ],
        "quotes": [
            "error",
            "double"
        ],
        "semi": [
            "error",
            "never"
        ],
        "no-console": [
            "off"
        ]
    }
}
```

**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**

<!-- Paste the source code below: -->
```js
var g = 1

[g].forEach(_ => _)

g = 2

`g`

var i = 3

/g/i.test("G") && console.log(g)
```

**What did you expect to happen?**
Three errors are detected as `no-unexpected-multiline`

- Before `g = 2`
- Before ``` `g` ```
- Before `/g/i.test("G") && console.log(g)`

**What actually happened? Please include the actual, raw output from ESLint.**
Only two errors were detected.

```
  3:1  error  Unexpected newline between object and [ of property access    no-unexpected-multiline
  5:5  error  Unexpected newline between template tag and template literal  no-unexpected-multiline

✖ 2 problems (2 errors, 0 warnings)
```
